caption: Figure 37: MSE Formulas (Harold Vance Department of Petroleum Engineering. Texas A&M University)

data.description: The figure provides formulas for calculating the total mechanical specific energy (MSETotal) in drilling operations. It breaks down MSE into three components: axial work, string rotational work, and bit rotational work. The formulas are given for general applications, motor applications, and MWD (Measurement While Drilling) applications. Each formula includes terms related to weight on bit (WOB), torque at the surface (TORSurf or TORmm), rotational speed (RPMSurf or RPMmm), drill collar diameter squared divided by rate of penetration (D^2(ROP)), and additional parameters for motor and MWD applications.
